links.effect: Overall accuracy 0.1 ± 0.7 mm (SI), -0.1 ± 0.8 mm (AP), 0.1 ± 0.7 mm (LR); within ±2 mm in all individual tests; latency 300 ± 100 ms.

screen.practice: FMEA-based risk mitigation (eligibility screening, staff training, workflow formalization)
screen.reason: The study empirically develops and evaluates an AI-driven image-guided radiotherapy system and conducts a formal Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to implement and measure the impact of clinical deployment safeguards (eligibility screening, staff training, workflow formalization) on risk priority numbers.

primary.practice: failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) risk mitigation
